ratings_why.fun: Every shop becomes a menu of texts and the misuses (an eating Stock, a mirror-backwards Pass) are a joy, but each board costs real reading effort.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7 because Guise turns the shop itself into the tribe's resource and leaves a visible Stock in the swapped unit's slot; no current tribe or stock auto-battler tribe plays that way.

verdict_why: v3 closed the Stock and Bee Orchid reading gaps; what's left is wording polish and UI work, not design fixes.

points.text: The fantasy lands in play: you take a shop unit, keep your own body, and a Stock is left where it stood. Keep the Stock visibly in the shop slot as the tribe's signature moment.
The Guise keyword runs to nine sub-rules. Most are edge cases; the card face should only need the first paragraph, with the rest in a tap-to-read glossary.
Michaelmas Mummers could say 'each different other tribe your Changelings wear' so players don't wonder if Changeling itself or fight-time guises count.
Coat-Peg Steward stacks guises without limit in a fight, while Grandfer Acorn is capped at 3; a note on how the stack is shown would help players follow it.
Grandfer Acorn could carry a nod to the eggshell test, such as shedding a guise when he remarks, so his card tells his story as well as Pip's and Penny's do.

standouts.why: Pip Unlike's mirror-backwards copy is one line, instantly readable, and pure character.
Wicker Moll makes the folklore's stock a real unit: one shop unit becomes two copies of its text.
Penny Second wearing the enemy and wiping its text is the 'household turns the real duchess away' story in one Start of Combat.

weakest.why: Leaf-Gold Pedlar is a plain gold trigger with no fairy-gold-turns-to-leaves flavour in what it does.
Coat-Peg Steward's growing stack of fallen guises is the hardest thing on the board to read mid-fight.
Cradle Foundling is just the keyword; fine as a seed but has nothing of its own.

flags.note: Unlimited stacked guises in a fight; how many texts it shows at once is hard to follow.
Whether the Changeling tribe itself counts as a worn tribe isn't stated.
Golden Lady with Grandfer and Glamour-Weaver gives very high rolls, as the designer notes.
